scope.purpose: Initial retrieval and grounded-answer acceptance gates for the Hotel ZGY demo.
scope.gatedRetrievalArm: Only the combined (production RetrieveAsync) retrieval arm is gated. Lexical-only and vector-only Recall@5 are reported as comparison numbers, not pass/fail.

retrievalPolicy.exactLookupProvenanceRule: An exact-fact hit carries its sourceId and sectionId and may be rank 1 in the final evidence list.

answerSupportRules.supported: Pass only when the response answers every part of the question and covers the case's expected claims (a multi-part answer that omits any part fails even if Recall@5 passes); every hotel fact it states is entailed by a passage that was actually retrieved for that case (any retrieved passage, not only the expected evidence keys); and it adds no invented hotel fact and nothing that contradicts the hotel information. A generic conversational referral to hotel staff or the front desk (for example, "please contact the front desk" or "ask hotel staff for details") is not a hotel fact and does not fail support, even when no retrieved passage mentions staff, provided it does not state or contradict a specific fact such as hours, a phone number, a cost, or a procedure that is not in a retrieved passage (Cecil Phillip, 2026-10-14). Naming a staff role, department, or service that no retrieved passage establishes (for example, "parking attendants") is an invented fact and fails; generic "hotel staff" does not (Cecil Phillip, 2026-10-15). Expected evidence keys measure retrieval (Recall@5) only.
answerSupportRules.staff_fallback: Pass only when the response gives no unsupported answer and does not guess, clearly says the hotel information does not establish the answer, and directly advises the guest to contact hotel staff. The referral must not name a staff role, department, or service that no retrieved passage establishes (for example, "parking attendants"); generic "hotel staff" or "the front desk" passes (Cecil Phillip, 2026-10-15). The retrieval result does not have to be empty: a related passage does not count as sufficient evidence (for example, phone-charger availability in guest rooms and conference rooms does not establish front-desk charger lending).

sourceIdConvention.identityRule: IDs describe stable document and semantic-section identities, not file paths or titles.
sourceIdConvention.editRule: Content edits keep their IDs; renaming or repurposing an ID requires updating every case, planned source, and corpusSnapshot entry that uses it.

reviewChecklist: Questions sound like realistic guest questions.
Expected evidence is necessary and sufficient.
Step 4 fictional facts are approved before dependent cases activate.
No-evidence requests are intentionally absent from the seed corpus.
Initial gates and scoring math are accepted.

provenance.role: Accepted Hotel ZGY scope, known geographic anchor, grounding, retrieval, and fallback rules.
Step 3 evaluation requirement and step 4/5 sequencing.
Stable chunk IDs, fixed evaluation set, multi-stage comparison, and RRF research.

plannedSources.notes: The location section in knowledge/hotel-zgy/property-overview.md records the fictional geographic anchor 2217 NW Miami Court, Miami, FL 33127 and the no-affiliation disclaimer. Approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-09 per user handoff.

knowledge/hotel-zgy/amenities.md records the fourth-floor gym location by the east elevators, pool availability, and phone chargers in guest rooms and conference rooms. Pool hours are separately approved in zgy-amenity-hours#pool-hours as of 2026-10-16. No pool location or front-desk charger lending is stated. Approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-09 per user handoff.

The gym-hours section states the fitness room is open 24 hours daily (approved 2026-10-09). The pool-hours section states the pool is open from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-16. No pool timezone, daily schedule, or location is established.
knowledge/hotel-zgy/policies.md records 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time checkout and the late-checkout policy, including the concierge limitation. Approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-09 per user handoff.

knowledge/hotel-zgy/services.md records room service from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. to 1:00 a.m. Eastern Time (concierge cannot order; guests can call the front desk and ask for room service), a 24-hour front desk reached by dialing 0 from the room phone, tagged-luggage holding until 8:00 p.m. on checkout day (not overnight), and shuttle availability with no approved schedule or pickup location. Approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-09 per user handoff; staff-contact facts approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-14.

The guest-wi-fi section in knowledge/hotel-zgy/connectivity.md states guests use their room number to access guest Wi-Fi. It does not call the room number a password and names no network. Approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-09 per user handoff.

Cecil Phillip approved the first-floor location, 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. hours, drinks, snacks, over-the-counter pain and cold medication, toothpaste, mouthwash, souvenirs, and front-desk or store referral for specific brands and sizes on 2026-10-16. No brand, size, price, medical advice, timezone, or daily schedule is established.

The ev-charging section in knowledge/hotel-zgy/parking.md states EV charging is available at the north end of the building. It makes no garage or parking-price claim. Approved by Cecil Phillip on 2026-10-09 per user handoff.

corpusSnapshot.rule: Every Markdown file under the root is listed with its repository-relative path, front-matter sourceId, SHA-256 of the exact file bytes, and byte length. Captured after the 2026-10-16 user-approved pool-hours and convenience-store updates and before comparison runs against this snapshot.
